name: pond3r/ggpo
description: Good Game Peace Out rollback network SDK enabling input prediction and speculative execution for peer-to-peer games, pioneering low-latency netcode for fighting games.
score_rationale: The original rollback netcode library with 3.5k stars, adopted widely in fighting game ports (Street Fighter, Skullgirls) and cited by nearly every modern rollback implementation.

name: RevenantX/LiteNetLib
description: Lite reliable UDP library for .NET Standard 2.1 / Mono supporting Unity, Godot, and MonoGame; provides minimal-overhead reliable/unreliable messaging with peer-to-peer support.
score_rationale: Go-to lightweight .NET UDP library with 3.5k stars, recently updated (2026) and widely used across Unity/Godot multiplayer projects.

name: facebookarchive/RakNet
description: Archived cross-platform C++ networking engine for game programmers once used in AAA game titles; now superseded by active forks and alternatives.
score_rationale: Historically significant game networking engine with 3.4k stars but archived since 2022; useful as reference but superseded by active alternatives.

name: mas-bandwidth/yojimbo
description: Network library for client/server games with dedicated servers, built on reliable UDP with encrypted packets, connection management, and support for competitive multiplayer games by Glenn Fiedler.
score_rationale: Well-regarded C++ networking library with 2.7k stars by a respected game networking expert, actively maintained through 2023 with a clean client/server model.

name: FirstGearGames/FishNet
description: Feature-rich Unity networking solution with server-authoritative design, client-side prediction, and support for Steam, Epic Online Services, WebRTC, and consoles.
score_rationale: Growing Unity networking alternative with 1.9k stars, actively maintained (2026) with client-side prediction and broad platform support; gaining adoption as Mirror alternative.

name: RiptideNetworking/Riptide
description: Lightweight C# networking solution for multiplayer games working in Unity and other .NET environments, with built-in UDP and TCP transports and Steam support.
score_rationale: Lightweight C# networking library with 1.3k stars, actively maintained (2025) and popular for small-to-medium multiplayer games.

name: rameshvarun/netplayjs
description: Framework for building peer-to-peer WebRTC multiplayer browser games with rollback netcode, requiring no server hosting or network synchronization code from the developer.
score_rationale: Innovative WebRTC P2P rollback netcode framework for browsers with 556 stars; limited community but unique niche for browser-based multiplayer.

name: wren-lang/wren
description: A small, fast, class-based concurrent scripting language designed for embedding in applications. Features lightweight fibers for concurrency, a clean C API, and compiles as C99 with no external dependencies.
score_rationale: 7.9k stars, the go-to modern embeddable scripting language for game developers wanting a clean, performant alternative to Lua.

name: luau-lang/luau
description: A fast, safe, gradually typed embeddable scripting language derived from Lua 5.1, developed by Roblox and used in Alan Wake 2 and Farming Simulator 2025. Adds type annotations and improved performance.
score_rationale: 5.4k stars, actively maintained through March 2026, proven at Roblox scale and adopted by multiple AAA titles.

name: ThePhD/sol2
description: A high-performance, header-only C++ library for binding Lua to C++ with type safety, support for all Lua 5.1+ versions, and extensive container and STL integration.
score_rationale: 5k stars, the standard choice for integrating Lua into C++ game engines with near-zero overhead and full Lua API coverage.

name: mruby/mruby
description: A lightweight, embeddable implementation of the Ruby language designed to be linked into applications, featuring a bytecode compiler, interactive shell, and amalgamation build for easy integration.
score_rationale: 5.5k stars, the canonical embedded Ruby runtime used in game engines and tools requiring Ruby scripting.

name: rhaiscript/rhai
description: An embedded scripting engine for Rust with JavaScript-like syntax, sandbox isolation, no-std and WASM support, providing safe and easy game scripting for Rust-based game engines.
score_rationale: 5.2k stars, actively maintained through early 2026, the standard embedded scripting solution for Rust game developers.

name: ChaiScript/ChaiScript
description: A header-only embedded scripting language designed from the ground up for C++17, offering type-safe bindings to C++ classes and functions without extra tooling or build steps.
score_rationale: 3.1k stars, uniquely designed to feel native to C++ game engine codebases with zero-dependency header-only integration.

name: albertodemichelis/squirrel
description: The official repository for the Squirrel scripting language — a lightweight, Lua-inspired, object-oriented scripting language used in Left 4 Dead 2, Portal 2, and War Thunder.
score_rationale: 1k stars, widely used in Valve games and AAA titles, proven in production game scripting for over a decade.

name: GaijinEntertainment/quirrel
description: A stricter, safer, faster evolution of Squirrel developed by Gaijin Entertainment (War Thunder), featuring coroutines, exception handling, and improved static analysis tooling.
score_rationale: 217 stars, niche but production-proven in major titles from Gaijin Entertainment, represents the modern evolution of the Squirrel language.

name: pterodactyl/panel
description: A free, open-source game server management panel built with PHP, React, and Go that isolates game servers in Docker containers, supporting Minecraft, Rust, Terraria, and many more titles via a community ecosystem.
score_rationale: The most popular self-hosted game server management panel with 8.7k stars, MIT-licensed, widely used by gaming communities and hosting companies.

name: googleforgames/quilkin
description: A non-transparent UDP proxy designed for large-scale multiplayer game server deployments, providing security, access control, telemetry, and metrics without requiring changes to game clients or servers.
score_rationale: Specialized and production-proven UDP proxy for game servers with 1.5k stars, written in Rust for high performance and maintained through early 2026.

name: EbTech/Elo-MMR
description: A Rust/C++ package implementing multiple rating systems for multiplayer competitions including Elo-MMR, Glicko, TrueSkill, and Codeforces algorithms designed for scalable competitive ranking.
score_rationale: Solid multi-algorithm rating system implementation for competitive games with 211 stars, relevant but narrowly scoped to skill ranking rather than orchestration.

name: ocornut/imgui
description: Dear ImGui is an industry-standard bloat-free immediate mode GUI library for C++ used extensively in game engines and tooling. Supports DirectX, Vulkan, OpenGL, Metal, and more with minimal dependencies.
score_rationale: The de facto standard for in-game tooling and debug UI with 72k stars and near-universal adoption across game engines.

name: emilk/egui
description: An easy-to-use immediate mode GUI in Rust that runs on both web (WASM) and native platforms. Widely used for game tooling via bevy_egui integration.
score_rationale: The go-to immediate mode GUI for Rust game development with 28.5k stars and active maintenance as of March 2026.

name: Immediate-Mode-UI/Nuklear
description: A minimal-state, immediate-mode graphical user interface toolkit written in ANSI C as a single-header library with no external dependencies. Cross-platform and highly portable for game tools.
score_rationale: Highly popular single-header C GUI library with 11k stars, widely used for lightweight in-game debug interfaces and tools.

name: rxi/microui
description: A tiny (~1100 lines) portable immediate-mode UI library written in ANSI C with no dynamic allocation. Provides built-in controls (windows, buttons, sliders) that work with any rendering system.
score_rationale: Highly regarded minimal GUI reference implementation with 5.7k stars, ideal for constrained or embedded game contexts.

name: raysan5/raygui
description: A simple and easy-to-use immediate-mode GUI library designed as an auxiliary module for raylib, providing 25+ controls as a single-file header-only library with a powerful icon and styling system.
score_rationale: Official UI companion to the popular raylib game library with 4.8k stars, widely used by indie developers for game tools.

name: mikke89/RmlUi
description: A C++ user interface library implementing HTML/CSS standards for creating interactive in-game UIs. Generates rendering primitives for integration into any renderer, used in shipped games like Killing Time Resurrected.
score_rationale: Production-proven HTML/CSS-based in-game UI library with 3.9k stars, MIT-licensed and actively maintained with real shipped-game usage.

name: thedmd/imgui-node-editor
description: A node editor implementation using Dear ImGui's API, designed as a basis for blueprint editors. Handles node placement, dragging, zooming, and Bezier curve links with full ImGui integration.
score_rationale: Widely adopted imgui-based node editor with 4.4k stars, actively maintained and commonly used for visual scripting tools in game engines.

name: CedricGuillemet/ImGuizmo
description: An immediate-mode 3D gizmo library built on top of Dear ImGui for manipulating 4x4 float matrices (translate, rotate, scale) in game editors and scene tools.
score_rationale: The standard 3D transformation gizmo for ImGui-based game editors with 3.8k stars and broad integration across game engine tools.

name: Nelarius/imnodes
description: A small, dependency-free node editor extension for Dear ImGui, supporting customizable nodes, pins, links, and a minimap for navigating large graphs in an immediate-mode style.
score_rationale: Solid lightweight node editor for ImGui with 2.4k stars, though development slowed after 2022.

name: yasirkula/UnityIngameDebugConsole
description: A uGUI-based in-game debug console for Unity that displays logs, warnings, errors, and exceptions at runtime in builds, with support for custom commands and Android logcat integration.
score_rationale: The most popular Unity runtime debug console with 2.6k stars, actively maintained through 2026 with minimal performance overhead.

name: fairygui/FairyGUI-unity
description: A flexible cross-platform UI framework for Unity featuring FairyBatching draw-call optimization, rich text, virtual lists, gesture recognition, and support for mouse, touch, and VR controllers.
score_rationale: Production-grade Unity UI framework with 2.9k stars offering significant draw-call optimization for complex game UIs, maintained through 2025.

name: imgui-rs/imgui-rs
description: Safe Rust bindings for Dear ImGui providing high-level APIs, low-level bindings, and integrations with glow, winit, and SDL2 backends for game tool development in Rust.
score_rationale: The primary Rust bindings for Dear ImGui with 3k stars, stable and widely used in Rust game tooling despite less frequent updates.
